term: no organ versus operation of the principle itself
resolution: No bodily instrument is a negative capacity statement. PerSeIntellectualOperation positively attributes an exercise to the principle and excludes bodily participation in it. NonorganicOperationAttribution is the separate source-attributed conditional linking them with non-bodyhood. Neither predicate denies object-side bodily conditions. Attribution remains qualified by ad 2: more properly the human being understands through the soul.
